short: Emily provides personalized, functional and holistic nutrition counseling for women with PCOS/PMOS who want to better understand their symptoms and feel more confident managing their health. Through her 1:1 Hormone Harmony Method, she takes a root-cause approach that considers nutrition, lifestyle, stress, sleep, and mindset to support hormonal health and sustainable changes without restrictive diets or one-size-fits-all plans. Hormone Harmony Method | Six-Month 1:1 PCOS/PMOS Program — $1,500

A personalized, six-month virtual nutrition coaching program designed to help women with PCOS/PMOS better understand their symptoms and build a sustainable approach to hormonal health.

Your investment includes:
- 90-minute Deep Dive Assessment: Explore your health history, symptoms, nutrition, and lifestyle to identify potential contributing factors.
- Personalized PCOS/PMOS Roadmap: Receive a science-informed plan tailored to your unique goals, needs, and lifestyle.
- 12 biweekly 45-minute coaching sessions: Implement your plan, work through challenges, track progress, and make adjustments along the way.
- Ongoing between-session support: Receive accountability, feedback, and guidance to help you stay consistent.

long:
Emily specializes in virtual nutrition counseling for women with PCOS/PMOS who are ready to take a more personalized approach to their health. Her practice combines functional and holistic nutrition with individualized lifestyle support to help women better understand their symptoms and identify factors that may be contributing to their hormonal concerns.

Through her signature 1:1 Hormone Harmony Method, Emily helps women build a stronger foundation for hormonal health by addressing nutrition, stress, sleep, digestion, movement, and mindset. Rather than relying on restrictive diets or quick fixes, she emphasizes sustainable, realistic changes tailored to each woman's unique needs, preferences, and goals. Emily believes women deserve to feel heard, supported, and empowered to make informed decisions about their health. Her compassionate, collaborative approach provides the education, guidance, and accountability women need to work toward more regular cycles, clearer skin, and a greater sense of confidence and control over their health.
size: 4 days per week and hiring a virtual assistant
